en.title: The Grand Tour Returns: Bourgeois, Holland, Engelsman Back for Season 2
en.summary: Prime Video has officially renewed the hit motoring series 'The Grand Tour' for a second season. The show will continue with its new trio of hosts, promising more global adventures and high-octane challenges.
en.body:
Fans of global motoring adventures can breathe a sigh of relief, as Prime Video has officially confirmed a second season for **The Grand Tour**. The show, which debuted in 2026, will continue to feature its fresh hosting team: **Francis Bourgeois**, **Thomas Holland**, and **James Engelsman**. This renewal comes as a welcome surprise, building on the foundation laid by the trio’s initial run.

The first season of **The Grand Tour** introduced viewers to a new era for the beloved franchise, steering clear of the Clarkson, Hammond, and May era but retaining the core spirit of epic journeys and automotive exploration. The show promised "new stories and exploring far flung locations all with a healthy side of competition," according to Prime Video’s initial announcement for the upcoming season. With six episodes planned for the sophomore outing, audiences can expect the series to delve into more ambitious stunts, explore diverse landscapes, and pit the hosts against each other in their usual competitive fashion.

## A New Era Takes the Wheel

**The Grand Tour** has always been about more than just cars; it's about the chemistry between its presenters and their often-chaotic adventures. While the original trio of **Jeremy Clarkson**, **Richard Hammond**, and **James May** set the benchmark, the introduction of **Francis Bourgeois**, **Thomas Holland**, and **James Engelsman** aimed to inject new energy and a contemporary perspective into the format. The success of Season 1 in retaining and attracting viewers suggests that this new iteration has found its footing, proving that the show’s appeal extends beyond its original stars. The focus on "global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions" remains a winning formula, and the decision to bring back the current hosts indicates that this approach resonated with the Prime Video audience.

## Fan Reaction and What's Next

The immediate reaction from the passionate **Grand Tour** fanbase has been overwhelmingly positive. Many viewers expressed their satisfaction with the new hosts, highlighting their unique personalities and the fresh dynamic they brought to the screen. The series has cultivated a dedicated following on mobile platforms, drawn to its blend of informative car reviews, spectacular cinematography, and genuine camaraderie. The renewal is seen not just as a continuation of a show, but as a solid endorsement of the direction the franchise has taken, assuring fans that their favorite motoring spectacle will continue to deliver the thrills they crave.

## Looking Ahead

Details regarding the filming locations and specific challenges for **The Grand Tour** Season 2 have not yet been announced. However, with the renewal secured, production is expected to ramp up soon, with a potential release window in late 2027 or early 2028. Fans will undoubtedly be eager to see where **Francis Bourgeois**, **Thomas Holland**, and **James Engelsman** will take them next.
